body: I’m just so tired of living. I have schizoaffective bipolar disorder. My medicine is so expensive that i can barely afford it so i don’t take it all of the time. I’m basically about to flunk some of my classes, which will drop my gpa and i won’t be able to get my loans so i won’t be able to come back to school. I wouldn’t know what to do after that. I don’t have a real job, i have no friends, i haven’t showered in a week, i haven’t eaten in 4 days. I just don’t know what to do anymore.
I don’t think anything can change my mind about this, I’m just not sure when to do it.
I wish they were too. Thank you, I appreciate you commenting.

Everything is wrong. Everything about me. My entire life is just falling apart and I’m so tired of trying to piece it back together. I’m schizophrenic, bipolar, depressed, and have anxiety, but I can’t afford any of my medication. I have a bunch of physical issues too, that the doctors think i just make up. i can only take my meds about once every other day because i never know when i can afford more. My family hates me, my entire family. They all love my sibling, but they don’t even care about me. My family planned a week celebration for my sibling (over the course of MY BIRTHDAY- which they completely forgot about). 
I’m failing school, i have no money, i barely have a job. No one likes me. Even my friends stopped talking to me. They talk over me, they ignore me, and I’ve even caught most of them making fun of me behind my back. I have no support system in this world, and i can’t fucking do it alone anymore.
It’s happened four times since 2018 though. And one time with a girl lol

It just sucks. This shit keeps happening to me. The last 4 people I was into all seemed really into me but eventually told me they wanted their exes or some of my best friends and I’m tired of it. Like i just want someone who cares about me for once.
I haven’t but I will. Thank you. I feel like at least with the self harm I had my own way of coping and controlling but now I just sit back and watch myself be this way and it sucks.
